name: Deploy & operations
tagline: One Worker: deploy, health gate, alerts
summary: How DiffKit is built, shipped and watched: one Cloudflare Worker deployed with Void, a health endpoint, automatic rollback, and alerts that open GitHub issues.

flow.label: PR checks
flow.note: Lint, type check and unit tests; separate workflows run e2e and a dev-server smoke test.

flow.label: Deploy workflow
flow.note: On a push to main, checks the resource pins and runs the deploy script.

flow.label: Deploy script
flow.note: Runs void deploy, waits up to 2 minutes for health, rolls back on failure.

flow.label: Worker entry
flow.note: Serves every request, adds security headers and turns a crash into a 503.

flow.label: Health endpoint
flow.note: Reports D1, KV, the serving version and the last maintenance cron run.

flow.label: Alert watchdog
flow.note: Every 15 minutes opens or closes GitHub issues for four production checks.

features.name: Void deploy on Cloudflare
features.summary: void deploy builds and ships one Worker with D1, KV and R2. A first deploy creates them in your own Cloudflare account; production pins existing ones.

entry.role: Step-by-step guide for your own instance

features.name: Health gate and rollback
features.summary: After a deploy the script polls /login and /api/health for up to 2 minutes. If the new version never reports healthy, it runs wrangler rollback.

features.name: CI workflows
features.summary: Six workflows: PR Checks, E2E, Dev Smoke, D1 migration check, production deploy and production alerts.

entry.role: Deploy job, runs on push to main

features.name: Health endpoint
features.summary: GET /api/health needs no sign-in. It returns 200 when D1 and KV answer, 503 otherwise, with the serving version and how long ago the cron ran.

entry.role: D1 and KV probes with a 5 s timeout

features.name: Production alerts
features.summary: A script opens one GitHub issue per failing check and closes it on recovery: health failing, D1 above 8 GB, cron not clean, Worker errors above 5%.

entry.role: Opens or closes the issue for a check

features.name: Security headers and safe errors
features.summary: Every response gets HSTS, nosniff, frame-deny, referrer and permissions headers. API routes fail to a 503, and logged errors have tokens stripped.

entry.role: Removes tokens and SQL params from logs

features.name: Local dev scripts
features.summary: pnpm dev checks the toolchain, .env and ports before starting Vite. In a git worktree it links .env from the main checkout and shares its local state.

entry.role: pnpm dev: config checks before Vite starts

goodParts: Deploy and rollback are documented phase by phase in docs/runbooks/deploy-rollback.md and implemented in one 213-line script.
The watchdog reads D1 size from the Cloudflare API, so that alert works when the Worker is down; a check it cannot run opens an issue too.
watch: No Content-Security-Policy header: security-headers.server.ts sets five headers and none of them is a CSP.
apps/dashboard/vite.config.ts is 412 lines, mostly hand-written stub plugins for shiki, Better Auth dialects and hugeicons.
Dev ports are fixed at 3000 and 4001 (scripts/dev-env.mjs:13, dev-demo.mjs:16), so two checkouts cannot run pnpm dev or dev:demo at once.
